President Trump hosted Chinese leader Xi Jinping for a high-profile state visit marked by lavish ceremonies and discussions on trade and AI. However, the event was overshadowed by Xi's apparent physical frailty, domestic instability in China, and violent clashes between paid pro-CCP supporters and pro-democracy protesters in Washington and New York.
